messages:
zoe: quick brief idea — one-sheet that bundles security controls, SLA bullets, and a tiny deploy-mode decision strip for webinar follow-up + gated download.
max: love it. keep it skimmable: top value sentence, 3 short boxes (Security, SLA, Deploy tradeoffs) and 1 CTA.
hannah: security bullets: customer KMS/HSM, customer-managed keys, audit logs/SIEM hooks, data residency options. add legal-note: avoid absolute compliance claims until review.
omar: SLA bullets: target SLOs per mode, 95th pct latency callout for Dedicated, fallback behavior (dedicated -> hosted). include a one-line "when to choose" guidance.
zoe: benchmark callout (provisional): "Estimated 95th pct latency ~85ms on Dedicated (8k ctx, KV warm); estimated ~$0.48 / 1k tokens for a chat assistant workload" — need infra signoff, mark provisional.
max: marketing ops — downloads should create inbound lead with tag `ent_brief_secure_sla` and capture account_size, compliance_needs, requested_feature, security_priority. route like below.
ops-bot: suggested routing pseudocode:
```
if lead.tag == "ent_brief_secure_sla":
  if lead.account_size >= 1000000:
    route -> enterprise_AE_queue
  elif lead.compliance == true:
    route -> solutions_engineering
  else:
    route -> growth_AE_pool
```
hannah: add `requested_trial` field so sales can offer a dedicated trial quickly. also include a 1-line ROI for finance: "Predictable unit costs and lower infra ops vs self-hosting."
omar: sales play: 3 qualifying q's (data residency, peak QPS, auditors) + 2 common objections + 30s talk track. AEs should use consistent language.
zoe: webinar CTA: "Watch 30m: Deploy Modes for Regulated Orgs" + link. followup email should attach the PDF + 3 micro benchmark charts.
max: timeline: draft copy by Tue, design by Thu, ops to implement SFDC mapping by Fri. infra + legal signoff before publish.
hannah: i'll draft security copy and send to legal; omar will chase infra for safe bench numbers.
zoe: thanks — i'll drop an initial draft doc and ping here for reviews. :rocket:
